newsitem.title: USA: Salant stake lifted by DDJ Capital group.
newsitem.headline: Salant stake lifted by DDJ Capital group.

text.p: A group led by DDJ Capital Management LLC, a Wellesley, Mass.,-based investment firm, said Thursday it raised its stake in Salant Corp to 1,316,000 common shares or 8.91 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 160,600 additional shares of Salant between October 24 and November 4 for $596,977.
The group previously held a 7.84 percent stake in the New York-based apparel maker. It said it holds the stake for investment.
